Strategy: Fill the loosest of the tight half. Split at the mean residual: use the loosest bin at or below the mean, and keep the loose half for big items. Score by residual in the tight half, penalizing the loose half below every tight bin, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the tightest is not the loosest of its half. It may help by reserving loose bins, but may fail by spreading items instead of finishing tight bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    avg = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    mx = max(bins)
    return [r if r <= avg else -(r - item) - mx for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Tight-half worst-fit: loosest bin at/below mean residual; loose half penalized below all tight bins.
